title: Center Stage Dance Studio
specs: Founder and director Annie DuLong Close has over twenty years of teaching experience and a Master’s Degree in Human Movement Education from Boston University.
Annie's performance resume includes five seasons as a New England Patriots Cheerleader and performances with Ricky Martin.
Dancers have performed at major events like the MLS Championship Halftime Show with Christina Aguilera.
gap: Class offerings, prices, durations, and age requirements are not stated on the website.
blurb: Center Stage Dance Studio provides dance education in a supportive and encouraging atmosphere. Founded and directed by Annie DuLong Close, the studio nurtures the love of dance for students of all ages and skill levels. Annie has extensive teaching and performance experience.
